title: Text: KC Tony Tijerna ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Anthony, no worries. I know how hectic things get at the end. In FL covering Nats IL, flying to AZ tonight for meetings. Looking forward to the off season. Take care. Will stay in touch. Thanks, TJ
